events.title: Meeting at the Polish border
events.summary: Chmielnik Jews met at the Polish border in 1920 to cross it.
events.uncertaintyNote: The OCR has an apparent typo in the word for year.

events.title: First Tel Aviv tannery established
events.summary: The first tannery in Tel Aviv was established in the Pardes by Chmielnik natives, including Dov Naftali Diamant, Chaim Kavshnibsky, and Berl Kavshnibsky.
events.uncertaintyNote: The OCR location and some names are unclear.

events.title: Departure from Lwów
events.summary: The group left Lwów on February 1 and traveled by train.

events.title: Shooting of 18 Jews
events.summary: Eighteen Jews were shot on the first day the town was in German hands; the passage does not identify who shot them.
events.uncertaintyNote: The text does not explicitly attribute the shooting to German forces.
